verdict.rationale: Gladia documents its own audio-intelligence layer that produces AI-generated insights from the user's audio data. This includes running LLMs directly on audio, sentiment and emotion extraction, and priced summarization and named-entity-recognition add-ons that 'enrich audio'. These are thin one-line mentions, all delivered as API outputs, and nothing shows proactive suggestions or an in-product insights surface. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, detailed docs on the LLM/audio-intelligence prompting feature, an in-product (UI) insights experience beyond API output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
